requirements_summary: Primary workload: multi-turn chat agents embedded inside product UI; must support tool calling (inventory lookup, order status) and structured function responses
Latency SLO: p95 end-to-end < 250ms for short responses, prefer streaming partials under 150ms for first token; target token-throughput during peak 60-100 requests/sec
Reliability: failover to alternate model variant or region on capacity issues; can tolerate graceful degradation (shorter context or caching) rather than hard 5xx
Security: corporate SSO (SAML) enforced for admin console; audit logs with token-level tracing; SOC2 compliance required for contract; ability to redact PII from logs before retention
Data residency: US-only for production; want option for VPC/dedicated pool for regulated customers
Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget; willing to trade some latency for cost but expect clear calculator and per-route cost breakdowns
